headline: CNT rallies 51% over five days, posting a 2.78% gain and an 18.8% intraday surge on a 10σ volume spike.
market_take: Construction stocks led the market with strong price and volume activity, while property names faced broad declines. PF&REIT and Food showed mixed signals, including volume spikes and price gaps. Overall, the market is tilted toward short‑term trading opportunities amid heightened volatility.

sector_notes.note: CNT posted a 2.78% rise, an 18.80% intraday move and a 10.0σ volume spike, while TPOLY recorded an 11.11% intraday rise and a director resignation. TRITN and BJCHI also generated large volume spikes (12.0σ and 4.3σ).
PF fell 20.00% and EVER dropped 14.29% on modest volume; JCK and STELLA each slipped 7.69% intraday. KC filed medium‑risk financial transaction and capital‑change notices.

M-PAT fell 14.00% but surged 16.22% intraday with a 1.23 volume ratio; STECH (CONMAT) logged a 9.70% rise and 10.64 volume ratio. SSPF released a full earnings package, and several REITs reported capital reductions.
KSL rose 6.74% with a 6.15% intraday gain; ZEN showed a 10.0σ volume spike. CHOTI and PB opened with a -100.00% price gap, indicating possible delistings.
TL advanced 7.32% with a 10.00% intraday move and a 3.82 volume ratio; PPPM slipped 7.14%.
STECH recorded a 9.70% rise, an 8.2σ volume spike and a 6.52% intraday move; DCON fell 6.25%.
